Phase B. Extract the peek tool into its own `peek` repository (owner mankinskin), built as a single `peek` domain crate per contract `0da6894c`: the crate lib re-exports the internal `peek-api` crate and exposes transports as FEATURE-GATED binary targets (`peek-cli`, `peek-mcp`, and `compact-terminal-mcp`) built on the shared `transport-harness` (`dbe0e955`).

Follow the parent-tracker recipe (`858c5286`); migrate peek-scoped artifacts via the cross-store move tooling.

## Acceptance criteria
- `peek` builds independently: domain crate lib (primary) re-exporting internal `peek-api` + feature-gated transport bins (names preserved incl. compact-terminal-mcp) over the harness.
- transport bin smoke pass.
- peek-scoped artifacts migrated with reference integrity.
- Registered as a workflow-tools dependency.

## W18 validation review — 2026-10-17

Implemented `workflow-tools/peek/Cargo.toml` as the standalone public `peek` domain package: it re-exports `peek-api`, has empty default features, and gates bare `peek` and `peek-mcp` bins behind their matching features. Existing transport source paths remain in place.

Evidence:
- `cargo build --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --no-default-features`: exit 0 (26.95s).
- `cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --all-features`: exit 0 (4 suites).
- `cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --workspace`: exit 0 (8 passed, 9 suites).
- `cargo run ... --bin peek -- --help`: exit 0; bare CLI help rendered.
- `Cargo.lock` resolves `memory-kernel` from `git+https://github.com/mankinskin/memory-kernel?branch=main#07808a7e...`; root manifest has no `[patch]` section.
- `peek-mcp --help` is not a help surface: it starts stdio and exits 1 after stdin closes.

Blocker: `cargo run --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --all-features --bin compact-terminal-mcp -- --help` exits 101 because no such bin exists. No compact-terminal source, git-history candidate, or completed migration journal was found in the scoped peek repository, so no production migration was attempted without an approved batch. Canonical validation records: `.workflow-tools/test/specs/vt-w18-peek-domain-acceptance.json` and `.workflow-tools/test/executions/exec-w18-peek-domain-20261017.json` (both read back).

## W18 validation review — corrected 2026-10-17

The compact-terminal source was confirmed and relocated from `context-engine/memory-api` to `workflow-tools/peek`: `compact-terminal-api`, `compact-terminal-cli`, and `compact-terminal-mcp`. Source paths are absent after relocation; destination packages preserve `compact-terminal` and `compact-terminal-mcp` binary names.

Validation:
- `cargo test -p compact-terminal-api -p compact-terminal-cli -p compact-terminal-mcp`: exit 0, 27 passed / 9 suites.
- `cargo build --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --no-default-features`: exit 0.
- `cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --all-features`: exit 0, 6 suites.
- `cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml --workspace`: exit 0, 35 passed / 18 suites.
- bare `peek --help`: exit 0.
- Actual stdio MCP initialize requests returned JSON-RPC success (`protocolVersion` `2025-03-26`) from both `peek-mcp` and `compact-terminal-mcp`; their process exit 1 is EOF after the piped request, not handshake failure. Thus the roadmap `--help` commands are an unsupported-flag drift, not a reason to add a new help API.
- `Cargo.lock` retains remote `memory-kernel` git source and root `Cargo.toml` has no `[patch]`.

Canonical validation: `vt-w18-peek-domain-acceptance` and corrected passing execution `exec-w18-peek-domain-20261017`, both read back. Commits: source removal `context-engine/memory-api` `109bb966`; destination `workflow-tools/peek` `12db7f0`, `4d747e4`.

## W18 validation review — stdio smoke correction 2026-10-17

The prior MCP `--help` commands were stale: these stdio servers do not implement a help CLI. The canonical validation spec now runs `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File workflow-tools\peek\scripts\mcp-smoke.ps1 -ManifestPath workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml`.

The committed bounded smoke builds both binaries, sends `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, and `tools/list`, asserts protocol `2025-03-26`, expected `serverInfo.name`, tools capability, and nonempty tools, then verifies clean EOF exit 0. It passed for `peek-mcp` and `compact-terminal-mcp`.

Existing acceptance evidence remains: companion tests 27 passed/9 suites; all-feature test exit 0; workspace test 35 passed/18 suites; no-default build exit 0; patch-free remote `memory-kernel` lock source. Canonical spec/execution `vt-w18-peek-domain-acceptance` / `exec-w18-peek-domain-20261017` were updated and read back passing.

Source/destination readback: all three original compact-terminal source directories are absent and all destination manifests exist. `context-engine/memory-api` has no parent Cargo workspace manifest; its only coupled consumer is a name/package/binary descriptor in `memory-fixtures/startup_matrix.rs`, with no stale path, so it remains unchanged. Guidance paths now point to `workflow-tools/peek/crates/...`.

Remaining caller-owned gate: parent `workflow-tools` gitlink still records peek `b579b989...` and is modified locally by destination commits; it was not staged. W18 remains `in-review`, not done, pending that parent wiring and caller roadmap-gate adoption. Supplemental commits: `workflow-tools/peek` `ca67656`; `workflow-tools` docs `beb51f0`.

## W18 validation review — bounded stdio smoke correction 2026-10-17

Canonical validation is `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File workflow-tools\peek\scripts\mcp-smoke.ps1 -ManifestPath workflow-tools\peek\Cargo.toml`; it replaces stale unsupported MCP `--help` commands. It resolves Cargo's actual `target_directory` using `cargo metadata`, bounds metadata/build/handshake waits, drains stderr from process start, and on any assertion/timeout closes stdin, waits, then uses `Stop-Process -Id` only for that exact started child before disposal while retaining the primary diagnostic.

Exact command exit 0: both binaries completed `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, and `tools/list`; asserted protocol `2025-03-26`, correct identity, tools capability/nonempty list, and clean EOF exit 0. A deliberate invalid `PeekServerName` invocation exited 1 as expected and reported the child terminal exit 1 after stdin close—no child leak.

Existing evidence remains: compact companion tests 27 passed/9 suites; all-feature test exit 0; workspace 35 passed/18 suites; no-default build exit 0; patch-free remote kernel lock. Spec/execution `vt-w18-peek-domain-acceptance` / `exec-w18-peek-domain-20261017` were updated and read back passed.

Source compact paths are absent; destination manifests exist. `memory-api` has no parent Cargo workspace; its only coupled consumer is name/package/binary descriptor with no stale path. Parent `workflow-tools` gitlink remains caller-owned at `b579b989...` and unstaged, so W18 remains `in-review`. Supplemental commit: `workflow-tools/peek` `47f98a024801ce432fa9891ec333e3a5d88c12d1`.
